svg.text: Simulated devices — the CONTROL UNIT: the remote weapon station and the 9K11 launcher box (SD-S4c, DESIGN_Simulated_Devices §3.13f)
Full colour = SPECIFIED by this mockup · grey dashed + 'unchanged' = CONTEXT, not specified · the picture, the tracers and the target are world effects, illustrative.
specified HUD element (full colour, dark halo — the station's HudText over the view)
Frames are 640 × 360 (16:9), the view riding the selected weapon's sight (DeviceView WeaponSight, D-152). Layout positions are PROPOSALS where the design is silent.
SELECT steps the weapon in STANDBY or ARMED · ARM needs the selected weapon loaded (D-112) · FIRE per press or held, by the weapon's kind

Every chip is a HudPanel button (D-122): clickable, with its hotkey badge (D-124 — the keys are proposals). The hover frame, the cursor and RMB-LOOK are the virtual adapter's (panels 16–19). For a console the look IS the lay (D-151).
20 · RWS CONSOLE, ARMED — the view through the gun's camera, the lay marker (dv-rws-mg)
Scope: the weapon-sight view with the reticle, the LAY marker, ammo, the fire mode, the aim readout, ZOOM, the READY
lamp, the six chips. The compass and the unit lines are context.
hold FIRE to fire · the stick slews the gun
the ARMED chip (green) · the selected weapon's lines: name, AMMO, FIRE MODE, and AZ / EL of the
ACTUAL aim (the replicated `TurretPose`) · the reticle at the weapon's aim · the LAY marker: the
commanded direction (`FireControl.LayDir`) relative to the actual aim, joined to the reticle by a dashed
line — the gun is still turning toward it · READY lamp (armed, a round, not paused) · ZOOM 4× · SELECT
greyed (one weapon), VIEW greyed (a gun has no flight to watch)
the compass · the unit lines · the picture and the truck (the weapon's camera, world)
The camera is on the WEAPON's turret and looks along its actual aim, so the operator sees the real drive lag (D-152): the lay
marker converges on the reticle as the turret arrives. The stick commands a slew RATE, never a position (D-151).
D-156 names SINGLE / BURST on this HUD, but D-154 gives the console no fire-mode channel: FIRE MODE here is a read-out
of the weapon's mode (a per-press weapon reads SINGLE, an automatic one BURST). A mode switch would need a channel —
PROPOSAL: the weapon lines, the AZ / EL readout, the marker's look, the corner brackets and the layout are mine; the design
names what the HUD shows, not where.
21 · RWS CONSOLE, FIRING — FIRE held, the burst and the ammo counting down (dv-rws-mg)
Scope: the FIRING lamp, FIRE set, the ammo falling, the lay marker converged on the aim, the message. Tracers and
the lamp turned red and relabelled FIRING (`FireControl.Trigger` held) · the FIRE chip set (blue) while
the key or the button is down · AMMO falling (amber below a quarter) · the lay marker nearly on the
reticle: the gun has arrived · 'FIRING' with the release hint
the compass · the unit lines · the tracers and the impacts on the truck (the rounds, world)
An automatic weapon fires while the trigger is HELD; a per-press launcher would fire once per press and the chip would flash
instead (D-149, `FiresPerPress`). The weapon's OWN brain fires — the console only raises `Trigger` (D-149, D-154).
PROPOSAL: the amber ammo threshold (a quarter of the belt) and the FIRING relabel are mine; the design names the held
22 · THE 9K11 BOX, ARMED — four launcher lamps, SELECT (dv-remote-launcher, dv-box-two-launchers)
Scope: the box's own sight (GuideFrom = Self), the launcher lamps with the selected one framed, ARMED, READY, the six
chips. The flight itself is panel 11 — the same box, GUIDING.
SELECT steps the launcher · FIRE launches
the box's name and the ARMED chip · the LAUNCHER lamps: 1 spent (greyed, crossed), 2 loaded and
SELECTED (gold frame), 3 loaded, 4 not connected (dashed) · the READY lamp for the selected launcher ·
'LAUNCHER 2 READY' · SELECT pressable (steps 2 → 3), FIRE pressable, VIEW greyed until a round flies
the compass · the unit lines · the picture and the tank
The box commands up to four uncrewed launchers on cables (D-155); each `Selected` index is a launcher of
`ControlledEntities` (D-147). ARM needs the SELECTED launcher loaded (D-154, D-112): selecting the spent launcher 1 would
show NO MISSILE and ARM refused.
The view is the box's own sight, not the launcher's camera (`GuideFrom = Self`, D-153): the round flies the line of the sight
he looks through, so the reticle is the guide line, as for the TOW sight unit (panel 8).
D-156 lists this panel as 'ARMED, a guided flight'; the flight half is drawn as panel 11 (the same chrome: lamp 1 in flight,
SELECT refused, the stick gauge) so the two do not repeat each other.
PROPOSAL: the lamp strip's place and look, the 8× field and the hotkeys are mine.
23 · RWS CONSOLE, PAUSED — FIRE and the lay held, the view still answers (dv-rws-paused)
Scope: the same HUD in pause: FIRE greyed, the lay marker held where it was (the stick is ignored), ZOOM still acting.
The toolbar's paused state is context.
the READY lamp off and FIRE greyed (a world effect is refused in pause, never queued — D-78, D-154) ·
the LAY marker held, tagged LAY HELD, while the stick is swung — the lay is integrated on live frames only
(D-151) · ZOOM 8× changed in pause and the picture magnified (observation) · the message 'FIRE HELD IN
the toolbar's run controls (paused) · the compass · the unit lines · the picture
Judged by dv-rws-paused: FIRE held through a pause and the stick swung hard — ⛔ `never` a shot during the pause, the turret
pose unchanged. Nothing turns, nothing fires; on resume the lay continues from where it was held.
No in-view PAUSED banner (as panels 5 and 15): the toolbar is the pause cue. PROPOSAL: the LAY HELD tag and the message's
words are mine; the design says the lay and the trigger are frozen, not how the HUD shows it.
